item.title: Rokoit Event
item.description: Celebrate your patron and gain his blessing for 21 days! Each month we will be celebrating a different Patron – this month, it’s Rokoit. Remember, you are as strong as chromium.

item.title: Happy Birthday, Allods!
item.description: Today we are celebrating the birthday of our beloved home - Allods Online!

item.title: Arisen Event: Opening of the Eyes
item.description: Open your eyes and celebrate the oldest race of Sarnaut - the Arisen!

item.title: Patronage Box and Jewelry Chest sale!
item.description: The Goblin Banker's Office announces the start of Patronage Box and Jewelry Chest sale!

item.title: The Battle Campaign: Boosters at a discount!
item.description: Don't miss the chance to purchase the boosters with a discount!

item.title: 16.1 — Shadows Over the Sandy Allod
item.description: Xadagan, a realm of endless deserts and ancient technologies, is swept up in a whirlwind of change. The eastern part of this allod, a symbol of progress, has become a battleground for secret wars, and a conspiracy is brewing in the sands that could overturn the very essence of Sarnaut...

item.title: Sale: Radiant Strongbox of the Archivist
item.description: New Radiant Strongboxes of the Archivist are available at the Boutique! These boxes can reward you with magic Sacrament artifacts which will grant your character up to 11 additional talent points!

item.title: The Magic Lamp Returns!
item.description: The Magic Lamp returns - making your dreams come true once again!

item.title: 16.1 — New heroic adventure “Hanging Gardens”
item.description: A mysterious allod has appeared in the boundless expanses of Sarnaut—the “Hanging Gardens,” where flora and fauna resemble the legendary Eden.

item.title: Day Of Fun!
item.description: Turn those frowns upside down in style with these fabulous wares! You'd need to be a 'fool' to miss out on the Day Of Fun!
